name: Basketry & Straw of the World
subtitle: Agaseke, Kiondo & more
shortDescription: 6 basketry and straw-weaving traditions to play: Botswana coil basket weaving, Agaseke basket weaving, Kiondo basket weaving and Bolga basket weaving.
longDescription:
Basketry & Straw of the World: 6 basketry and straw-weaving traditions from 6 countries, in one app that works fully offline.

Inside: Botswana coil basket weaving, Agaseke basket weaving, Kiondo basket weaving, Bolga basket weaving, Mesob basket weaving and Bijenkorfvlechten.

Each one has a short note on where it comes from and how it is played in the real world. You can weave baskets and straw craft, learn by watching a demonstration, and read the rules at any time.

No account needed. Works offline.
monetization: Free with ads, optional monthly ad-free
